entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hi... um, I hope you can help me. I got an order and I think I need to send it back. I'm just so confused by the whole process.
Hello, you've reached VeloFit. My name is Alex. I can certainly help you with that. To get started, could I have your order number, please?
Oh, okay. It's... VF-987-554. I bought a jersey and it just doesn't fit at all. I don't understand the website's sizing.
Thank you for that. I'm pulling up your order now. Just to be sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or a preference on the fit?
It's just the wrong size. It feels way too tight across my shoulders. I thought I followed the chart, but it's all so overwhelming. Can't you just help me?
Of course. It sounds like you'd be more comfortable in a different size. I see the order was delivered on January 1st, just four days ago. You are well within our 90-day return policy for apparel.
Oh, it's 90 days? I was so worried I missed the window. So... what can I do?
We can definitely get this sorted out for you. We can process an exchange for the next size up, or a full refund if you prefer. Which would you like to do?
An exchange would be perfect! I really love the color, I just need a larger size. Is it difficult?

Not at all, I can handle it for you right now. I'm initiating the exchange in our system. I've just sent a pre-paid return label to the email address on your account. All you need to do is package the original jersey, attach the label, and drop it off at the post office. Once the tracking shows it's on its way back to us, we'll ship out the new size.
Oh, that's such a relief. Thank you so much, Alex. You've made this so easy.
You're very welcome. I'm happy I could help. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that was everything. Thank you again.
Alright. Have a wonderful day, and thank you for calling VeloFit.
